prose: Clef announces open-source decision models and an RL fine-tuning platform, riding the buzz around TypeSafe AI's Jev System One. The post explains decision models as a different idea from classifiers: they produce bounded, structured outputs cheaply, quickly and consistently, can sit inside a workflow wherever a decision is needed, and handle new categories without retraining. It contrasts them with LLMs, which are largely non-deterministic. Based on the opening of the post.
highlights: Decision models give bounded, structured, consistent outputs
